newsitem.title: USA: Texas Meridian tests development well.
newsitem.headline: Texas Meridian tests development well.

text.p: Texas Meridian Resources Corp said Tuesday the well drilled at the initial development location of its Southwest Holmwood field discovery in Calcasieu Parish, La., tested at 12.6 million cubic feet of natural gas plus 1,051 barrels of oil daily.
The company said first sales from the Benn Todd No. 1 well are expected to start in mid-October.

The well encountered 39 feet of pay in the objective Marg Tex sand at a depth of 11,860 feet and was tested on 22/64 inch choke with a flowing tubing pressure of 6,046 pounds per square inch, Texas Meridian said. Shut-in tubing pressure is 6,620 pounds per square inch.
The company said it holds a 62 percent working interest until payout out of 300 percent of intangible costs plus 100 percent of tangible costs.

Thereafter, Amoco Corp will participate for a 50 percent working interest. The interests of Texas Meridian and its present partners H.L. Hawkins Jr. and Optima Petroleum Corp, now 25 percent and 8 percent, respectively, will then be reduced proportionately.
